caliber: EX 分母 = 聚合型题（含聚合函数或 GROUP BY）；纯检索题单列「架构不适用」不进分母
EX 判等走 run_in_sandbox 双跑 + compare_tables；不读 state[result_rows]（体积字段，恒 0 行）
花费按 state[cost_cny] 显式 float()（该键是字符串），逐题累加；app.cost_ledger 不参与评测侧
gold 取 train_spider.json 的 query 字段（官方发布）；比对器为本项目实现（官方 evaluation.py 不在盘）
语义包由 eval/spider/build_bundle.py 从 schema 机械派生，指标非业务口径；必须过 load_bundle

records.question: What is the name of the customer who has the most orders?
records.gold_query: SELECT T1.customer_name FROM customers AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
records.sql_text: SELECT c.customer_name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_row_count FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY orders_row_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: List the count and id of each product in all the orders.
records.gold_query: SELECT count(*) ,  T3.product_id FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id AND T2.product_id = T3.product_id GROUP BY T3.product_id
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(p.product_id) AS products_row_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.product_id LIMIT 1000

records.question: For each product, return its id and the number of times it was ordered.
records.gold_query: SELECT count(*) ,  T3.product_id FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id AND T2.product_id = T3.product_id GROUP BY T3.product_id
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_id AS product_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_items_row_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY order_items_row_count DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 1000

records.sql_text: SELECT COUNT(customers.customer_id) AS customers_row_count FROM Customers AS customers JOIN Accounts AS accounts ON accounts.customer_id = customers.customer_id LIMIT 100

records.question: How many customers don't have an account?
records.gold_query: SELECT count(*) FROM Customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Accounts)
records.sql_text: SELECT COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customers_without_account_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.account_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000
